risks.mitigation: Integrate examinations and refer to ophthalmology.
risks.scenario: Vision loss is treated only as a refractive problem.

risks.affected_roles: Optometrists, patients, and prescription delivery or dispensing personnel.
risks.consequence: May cause correction errors and usability problems.
risks.scenario: Power or left and right eyes are recorded incorrectly.
risks.title: Prescription error

risks.affected_roles: Patients, prescribing optometrists, and pharmacy collaborators.
risks.consequence: May cause medication harm or violate applicable licensing rules.
risks.scenario: Prescribing exceeds state or regional licensing.
risks.title: Overstepping medication

risks.affected_roles: Contact lens users, optometrists, and follow-up personnel.
risks.consequence: Eye injury or infection may occur.
risks.scenario: Hygiene and wearing education is insufficient.
risks.title: Contact lens injury

risks.affected_roles: Patients, optometrists, and the ophthalmology team receiving the referral.
risks.consequence: May delay emergency handling and damage vision.
risks.mitigation: Refer according to the emergency procedure.
risks.scenario: Eye pain or sudden vision loss is not escalated.
risks.title: Missed emergency referral

risks.affected_roles: Patients, optometrists, and medical record and imaging administrators.
risks.consequence: May leak medical records or imaging data.
risks.scenario: Ocular images or medical records are leaked externally.
risks.title: Privacy leakage
